title: On the Spectral Properties of Van Leer and AUSM Flux-Vector Splitting Schemes
summary: The flux-vector splitting scheme of Van Leer is a cornerstone of computational fluid dynamics, yet its original proof of the eigenvalue sign condition was presented in a condensed form. In this work, we provide a detailed and rigorous analysis of the eigenvalues of the Jacobian matrices associated with the Van Leer splitting for the one-dimensional Euler equations. By constructing the Sturm sequence of the discriminant, we prove that for the admissible parameter range $1 \le γ\le 3$, $|M| 0$, the Jacobian $\partial F^+/\partial U$ has one zero eigenvalue and two positive real eigenvalues,…
